🔴 THE THIRD CLAUSE IS WHY THIS SCENARIO IS BEING RESTORED. It produced 4 of the 6 recorded Tier-A false-'done' instances behind DQ-T71 — a claim of completion while the card was unclicked and nothing was written. Whether the server-appended suspend note (shipped 2026-08-28) changes that is UNMEASURED: the before/after I attempted was withdrawn because the post-note population contained ZERO runs of this scenario, so the comparison measured which scenarios ran rather than the note.
